Alessandro Schopf.note: Schöpf is midfield insurance for Austria. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Alessandro Schopf.noteZh: 他给Austria一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Alexander Prass.note: Prass is defensive cover for Austria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Alexander Prass.noteZh: 他是Austria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Alexander Schlager.note: Schlager has carried the keeper minutes for Austria. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Alexander Schlager.noteZh: 他是Austria防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Carney Chukwuemeka.note: Chukwuemeka gives Austria midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Carney Chukwuemeka.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Austria来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

David Affengruber.note: Affengruber gives Austria cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
David Affengruber.noteZh: 他是Austria后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

David Alaba.note: Alaba has supplied one of Austria's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
David Alaba.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Austria创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Dejan Ljubicic.note: Ljubičić is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Austria, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Dejan Ljubicic.noteZh: 他给Austria提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Florian Grillitsch.note: Grillitsch gives Austria a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Florian Grillitsch.noteZh: 他是Austria的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Florian Wiegele.note: Wiegele is Austria's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Florian Wiegele.noteZh: 他是Austria的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Kevin Danso.note: Danso gives Austria another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Kevin Danso.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Konrad Laimer.note: Laimer has one tournament assist in the bank for Austria. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Konrad Laimer.noteZh: 他已经帮Austria制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Marcel Sabitzer.note: Sabitzer has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Algeria. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Marcel Sabitzer.noteZh: 他已经为Austria进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Marco Friedl.note: Friedl is back-line insurance for Austria. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Marco Friedl.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Marko Arnautovic.note: Arnautović has already punished Jordan and Algeria for Austria. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Marko Arnautovic.noteZh: 他已经多次为Austria把机会变成进球。看他需要的空间有多小。

Michael Gregoritsch.note: Gregoritsch has already created a goal for Austria in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Michael Gregoritsch.noteZh: 他已经参与了Austria的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Michael Svoboda.note: Svoboda is defensive cover for Austria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Michael Svoboda.noteZh: 他是Austria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Nicolas Seiwald.note: Seiwald has been one of Austria's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Nicolas Seiwald.noteZh: 他是Austria这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Patrick Pentz.note: Pentz gives Austria a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Patrick Pentz.noteZh: 他在Austria首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Patrick Wimmer.note: Wimmer is an attacking change-up for Austria. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Patrick Wimmer.noteZh: 他是Austria的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Paul Wanner.note: Wanner is the midfield player Austria can use when possession needs a sharper touch near the box. He tries to make one small gap matter.
Paul Wanner.noteZh: 他给Austria一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Philipp Lienhart.note: Lienhart is defensive rotation for Austria. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Philipp Lienhart.noteZh: 他是Austria后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Phillip Mwene.note: Mwene gives Austria defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Phillip Mwene.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Romano Schmid.note: Schmid already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Jordan. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Romano Schmid.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Sasa Kalajdzic.note: Kalajdžić's World Cup has already included a goal against Algeria. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Sasa Kalajdzic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Stefan Posch.note: Posch gives Austria one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Stefan Posch.noteZh: 他是Austria无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Xaver Schlager.note: Schlager has supplied one of Austria's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Xaver Schlager.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Austria创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。
